analysis.title: US Equities Mid-Day Color (GS Equities Mid-Day Color, 11 Nov 2026)
key_insights: Institutional activity was quieter because of the bond market holiday, but the desk saw a clear re-risk back into semis and levered-AI names.

Retail is driving a large share of volume: three stocks, all priced under 4c, made up 32% of overall tape volume. This pushed the GS Retail Favs basket (GSXURFAV) up 6.46, its second best day in 3 years.
Neoclouds are helping drive a rotation back into Tech. The desk's CTA math says the follow-through has fuel, with meaningful CTA demand in an up-tape over the next 1 week and 1 month.
Semis are running 17% better to buy across the GS platform, driven largely by hedge funds, with long-only funds also adding. SOX is approaching the 200-day moving average at 10,865.
NVDA is down 540 bps since Monday while SOX is up 14% over the same period.
The hyperscaler group lagged the broader re-risk and looks to be used as a source of funds. NVDA is trying to recover part of the $430B of market cap lost this week.
GS floor activity is down 20% vs the trailing two weeks, while market volumes are up 13% vs the 10-day moving average.
The GS floor is 13% better to buy, driven by hedge fund demand. Hedge funds are +18% with large buy skews in Tech and Consumer Discretionary.
Long-only funds are only slightly better to buy overall. They are selling Tech and Consumer Discretionary to buy Health Care, Communication Services and Industrials.
Chart of the day: 12-month momentum (GSPRHIMO) outperformed shorter-term momentum by the most on record today, against both 3-month (GSPRHMO3) and 6-month (GSPRHMO6) momentum.
